properties.statement: [BL-171] Verification.location exists in the schema, is set on none of the 101, and the path lives in the node's NAME as prose
properties.value: {"evidence": "*Found 2026-08-02 by the derived coverage sweep built in [BL-170], on its first run: test files dominated the unclaimed list even though the design models every one of them.* The BL-23 granularity doctrine is one Verification per test file, and the design honours it \u2014 ver:detect is detect.rs, ver:heal is heal.rs. But coverage_report counts nodes carrying a location, and zero of 101 Verifications carry one; the path is written into name, e.g. *\"An acknowledgement is a statement ABOUT the design, not a part of it (crates/reflow2-core/tests/acknowledgement_not_structure.rs)\"*. So the design's knowledge of where its own tests live is real, recorded, and unqueryable \u2014 ~71 test files report as regions nothing claims, forever. This is [BL-165]'s shape a third time (the fact exists somewhere the machinery does not look) and [BL-129]'s shape exactly (Interface.medium unreachable from both tools that create Interfaces): add_verification does not accept location, so the schema property is unreachable from the surface that creates the node \u2014 which is *why* the path went into the nearest writable field. Not fixable by the build script alone: only 26 of the 101 come from its VERIFICATIONS table; the other 75 were authored in live sessions, so a script-side patch would leave a confusing half-state. Fix shape: add_verification takes location (surface change, toolsnap), then backfill \u2014 the script's 26 from its own table, the rest by parsing the paths already sitting in their names. Then coverage_report can finally see verification coverage, which is the one class of design knowledge it is currently blind to. Size S", "origin": "Migrated from docs/backlog.md BL-171 on 2026-08-07 (epoch:backlog-retired). Size estimate carried from the row: S."}
